note: D6 the draft deals ONE sibling per held base and which one is PARITY, not a roll: Content.variant_for indexes variants_of(base) by the floor being entered, so with variant A listed first in ABILITIES an even floor deals A and an odd floor deals B, and both siblings are draftable inside one run. Entering floor 2 the upgrade slot deals solar_lance+noon (A) - and the wild slot deals solar_lance+pierce on the same roll, because the universe holds BOTH siblings of a held base while the upgrade slot lists exactly one. The affinity offer (moss_filter, sun) is picked so the lance stays a held BASE, and entering floor 3 the upgrade slot deals moss_filter+prism (B) with seed_bomb+reclaim (B) behind it in wild. Freeze the parity - make variant_for return index 0 always - and the floor-3 upgrade slot deals moss_filter+sieve instead, so the record fails in plain mode on its last pattern. Because the choice is a table read and not a draw, the roll still spends EXACTLY one main-rng draw per slot (d4_starved_slot.json pins that contract), and the sibling a floor cannot deal is always buyable at the shrine forge (d6_forge_variant_a/b), so no fork is unobtainable. The floor-2 leg between the two drafts is a baked action list playing to the stairs; it is how the second descent is reached, not what the record is about
